visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair, wearing a purple polo-style sweater, faces the camera in a living room setting. A man in a dark shirt briefly appears behind her, gesturing jokingly. The background features a large amethyst geode and a green plant. (2) The woman gestures towards her face and body while bright graphic labels in Chinese appear. She then points toward her hands, and humorous text overlays surround her. The camera remains static at eye-level. (3) The scene shifts to a computer monitor showing a photo editing interface. A woman is seen holding a tube in a professional photo. The shot zooms in on the hands in the photo, highlighting wrinkles on the knuckles. (4) Footage shows the woman in a kitchen washing broccoli in a white strainer under running water. She is wearing a grey t-shirt. She then wipes her wet hands on her shorts as she walks away from the sink. (5) Back in the living room, the woman talks to the camera while her partner mimics her hand movements in the background. She turns to look at him and gestures for him to stop. (6) A series of close-ups show the woman applying hand cream from a purple tube onto her hands. The lighting is bright and even. Several tubes of different colors (pink, yellow, blue, purple) are shown lined up. (7) Montage sequences show the woman using the hand cream in various locations: at a desk with a laptop and an Eevee plush, in a bedroom, and inside an elevator taking a mirror selfie. (8) Macro shots focus on the texture of the cream being rubbed into the skin. The final shot returns to the woman smiling and waving her hands toward the camera, with the four tubes of INGENI hand cream displayed in the foreground.
